summary: Expose the live-verified per-item rename operation and document unverified metadata mutations.
reason: AnyList accepts item renames through the set-list-item-name protobuf handler. Add the safe CLI name field with stdin support, fresh live read-back verification, and local-cache synchronization. Do not expose category, price, or store/aisle writes because their candidate handlers returned HTTP success without changing a fresh user-data read.
validated_outcome: Rename round-tripped through set-list-item-name on a disposable marker item and was verified from fresh GetUserData before cache sync. Candidate category-match, price, and store-id operations were probed separately and did not round-trip; they remain unsupported. The marker list was deleted and independently confirmed absent.
